observations: The two independently labeled concentration axes prevent a false shared unit scale.
Bright blue circles and coral squares decode the actual genotypes with a second shape cue, including the endpoints.
The irregular 24–48 h interval has twice the horizontal length of the 12–24 h interval; mean anchors are exact linear source hours.
Definite thin trajectories and filled mean markers lead; open observations and compact SEM retain the source variability without a broad faded band.
Raw observations are visible at nominal PDF size and retain definite edges; the source duplicates have separate symbols.
No in-image title, narrative footer, count prose or panel lettering is added.
residual_notes: Some open raw symbols cross a trajectory and interrupt small segments; this is disclosed rather than claiming zero crossings.
The small raw display slots need the caption to avoid mistaking their categorical offsets for additional sampling hours.
Lung and serum have independent units and ranges; absolute vertical heights across panels must not be interpreted as directly comparable.
Numeric/export validation and this self-review do not prove top-journal quality or broadly improved Agent output.
